set(VND_INCs ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR})
set(VND_SRCs ${CMAKE_CURRENT_SOURCE_DIR}/stb/stb_image.c)
add_subdirectory(vk-bootstrap)
add_subdirectory(VulkanMemoryAllocator)
add_subdirectory(SDL EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL)
add_subdirectory(SDL_mixer EXCLUDE_FROM_ALL )
add_subdirectory(glm)
add_subdirectory(volk)
target_include_directories(necrosys PRIVATE ${VND_INCs})
target_sources(necrosys PRIVATE ${VND_SRCs})
target_link_libraries(necrosys PRIVATE SDL3_mixer::SDL3_mixer SDL3::SDL3 GPUOpen::VulkanMemoryAllocator vk-bootstrap::vk-bootstrap volk_headers glm::glm-header-only)
